persona.papel: garçonete em um restaurante em Nova York

nos.fala_ia: Hi there! Welcome in. Do you have a reservation, or is it just walk-in?
nos.resposta_alvo: No reservation, just two of us.
alternativas_aceitas: We don't have a reservation, table for two, please.
nos.dica_pt: Diga que não tem reserva e que são duas pessoas.

nos.fala_ia: No problem! Right this way. Here are your menus. Can I start you off with something to drink?
nos.dica_pt: Peça uma bebida, por exemplo água.

nos.fala_ia: Sure thing. Are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?
alternativas_aceitas: We need a couple more minutes, please.
nos.dica_pt: Diga que já estão prontos para pedir.

nos.fala_ia: Great, what can I get for you?
nos.resposta_alvo: I'll have the grilled chicken salad.
alternativas_aceitas: I'd like the grilled chicken salad, please.
nos.dica_pt: Peça a salada de frango grelhado.

nos.fala_ia: Excellent choice. Would you like any sides with that?
alternativas_aceitas: I'll take some fries on the side.

nos.fala_ia: Thanks for letting me know. I'll make sure the kitchen avoids that. Anything else?
Perfect, I'll get that started for you.
Here's your order! Enjoy your meal. Let me know if you need anything.
nos.dica_pt: Elogie a comida ao receber o pedido.

nos.fala_ia: How was everything? Can I get you some dessert or the check?
alternativas_aceitas: Could we have the bill, please?

nos.fala_ia: Sure, I'll bring that right over. Will this be one bill or separate?
nos.dica_pt: Diga que quer a conta junta.

nos.fala_ia: Of course! We have chocolate cake and cheesecake today.
nos.dica_pt: Escolha uma sobremesa, por exemplo cheesecake.

nos.fala_ia: Here you go. Have a great rest of your day!
